articles.title: Live: Ukraine, Russia hold second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
articles.excerpt: Washington called for a "new" security framework on the first day of US-led talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi, as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was "happy" with the changes in approach by US mediators. Negotiations are set to continue Wednesday. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
